title: ANY.RUN Threat Intelligence Lookup
description:
[ANY.RUN Threat Intelligence Lookup](https://any.run/threat-intelligence-lookup/?utm_source=opencti-marketplace&utm_medium=product-page&utm_campaign=lookup-integration-opencti&utm_term=250626&utm_content=linktolookuplanding) is a searchable database of live attack data. It allows SOC and MSSP analysts to check suspicious Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), Behavior (IOBs), and Action (IOAs) against a history of active malware and phishing attacks to understand the full context of an incident. The threat database is being continuously updated with fresh intelligence backed by the [ANY.RUN Interactive Sandbox's](https://any.run/features/?utm_source=opencti-marketplace&utm_medium=product-page&utm_campaign=sb-integration-opencti&utm_term=250626&utm_content=linktosandboxlanding) global community of 15,000 organizations and 600,000 analysts. 

**Key Capabilities:**

- **Instantly Enrich Incidents with Global Context:** Query the ANY.RUN database for details on suspicious IPs, domains, hashes, and over 40 more types of indicators to see if they have been involved in real-world attacks, allowing for a more confident assessment of every alert.
- **See the "How" Behind the Attack:** Rather than just seeing that an indicator is "malicious", you get behavioral context that explains exactly how an attacker operates, which is vital for building a stronger defense.
- **Update Your Protections Automatically:** Use the intelligence you find to create new security rules and update your response playbooks directly within OpenCTI, turning global data into local security.
- **Stop Breaches Before They Start:** By leveraging data from 15,000 organizations, your team can identify and block emerging threats before they even target your environment.
short_description: The ANY.RUN Threat Intelligence Lookup connector lets SOC teams search a massive database of live attack data from 15K organizations to enrich indicators with deep behavioral context and global threat telemetry.
